risks.risk: High shutter count indicating the camera is near the end of its mechanical life.
risks.proof: A screenshot from a shutter count utility (e.g., EOSCount or ShutterActuations) showing the serial number and total count.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having a shutter near failure.

risks.risk: Sensor damage, scratches, or fungus that would ruin image quality.
risks.proof: A clear, high-resolution photo of the image sensor with the mirror locked up and no body cap.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring a sensor replacement or professional deep cleaning.

risks.risk: Electronic failure or dead pixels on the LCD screen.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, navigating menus, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Missing battery and charger, which are expensive to source locally.
risks.proof: A photo showing the camera alongside its specific LP-E6 battery and charger.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a bare body only.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Photo of the battery and charger.
response.reason: The witness has confirmed the specific model as a Canon EOS 5D Mark II. It can be priced at a worst-case functional state until further proof is provided.
